description: Defines the MetaEntry class for managing HTML meta tags within OrchardCore resource management, including attribute handling and tag generation.

classes.name: MetaEntry
classes.description: Represents an HTML meta tag with properties for common attributes and methods for combining and rendering tags.

methods.name: MetaEntry
methods.description: Default constructor initializing the meta tag as self-closing.

methods.name: MetaEntry
methods.description: Parameterized constructor to initialize meta tag attributes.

methods.name: Combine
methods.description: Static method to merge two MetaEntry instances with a separator for content.

methods.name: AddAttribute
methods.description: Adds or merges an attribute to the meta tag.

methods.name: SetAttribute
methods.description: Sets or overwrites an attribute on the meta tag.

methods.name: GetTag
methods.description: Returns the HTML content representing the meta tag.
